name: Abiraterone acetate plus Prednisone (mCRPC)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Abiraterone is a CYP17 inhibitor and is not biomarker-restricted. Castrate testosterone (below 50 ng/dL) must be maintained with ongoing ADT. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Prostate Cancer, Systemic Therapy for M1 CRPC (PROS-18) and PROS-G.

supportiveCare: continue ADT to maintain castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL (PROS-G).
cycles null: continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
mandatory concurrent prednisone 5 mg PO twice daily with the standard abiraterone formulation.
after progression on abiraterone, adding dexamethasone 0.5 mg/day to abiraterone is a source-listed secondary hormone option (PROS-G, prostate line ~3007).
monitoring: PSA and serum testosterone (confirm castrate level)
liver function (hepatotoxicity), blood pressure, and serum potassium (mineralocorticoid excess)

doseModificationRules.text: Hold abiraterone and prednisone per labeling; resume at a reduced dose after recovery; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Abiraterone acetate
drugs.route: PO (once daily after an overnight fast)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026, PROS-G footnote b (prostate lines 2846 to 2849) and Discussion (prostate line 7230). Standard abiraterone acetate 1000 mg PO once daily on an empty stomach (after an overnight fast). MUST be given with concurrent prednisone (see prednisone entry). Fine-particle formulation and a low-fat 250 mg/day option exist per the same footnote; not modeled here.

provenance.locator: PROS-G footnote b, prostate lines 2846 to 2849 (standard formulation 1000 mg/day after an overnight fast); Discussion, prostate line 7230 (abiraterone 1000 mg orally once daily)

drugs.name: Prednisone
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Prostate v6.2026, PROS-G footnote b (prostate line 2847). Prednisone 5 mg PO TWICE daily in the CRPC setting with the standard abiraterone formulation. Mandatory companion steroid (with the fine-particle formulation, methylprednisolone 4 mg PO twice daily is used instead).

provenance.locator: PROS-G footnote b, prostate line 2847 (prednisone twice daily in the CRPC setting with the standard abiraterone formulation)
